273	
274	    问题段解码契约同 decode_query，但查询截断（问题区越界）、非法名字
275	    （含压缩问题）、AN/NS 非空、非法 AR/OPT 与尾随字节一律抛
276	    EDNSError；报文长度与问题数等其余错误仍抛 MessageError。AR 限 0 或
277	    1 条，有则须为未压缩根 owner、TYPE41、CLASS512..65535、扩展码/
278	    版本 0、flags 仅 DO、RDLENGTH0 的 OPT。
279	    """
280	    if not isinstance(data, bytes):
281	        raise TypeError("data must be bytes")
282	    if not _MIN_MESSAGE_LEN <= len(data) <= _MAX_MESSAGE_LEN:
283	        raise MessageError("bad message length")
284	    msg_id = int.from_bytes(data[0:2], "big")
285	    flags = int.from_bytes(data[2:4], "big")
286	    qdcount = int.from_bytes(data[4:6], "big")
287	    ancount = int.from_bytes(data[6:8], "big")
288	    nscount = int.from_bytes(data[8:10], "big")
289	    arcount = int.from_bytes(data[10:12], "big")
290	    if not 1 <= qdcount <= _MAX_QUESTIONS:
291	        raise MessageError("bad question count")
292	    if ancount or nscount:
293	        raise EDNSError("response sections must be empty")
294	    if arcount > 1:
295	        raise EDNSError("additional section must contain at most one OPT")
296	    boundaries = set()
297	    questions = []
298	    pos = _MIN_MESSAGE_LEN
299	    for _ in range(qdcount):
300	        try:
301	            name, pos = _read_name(data, pos, boundaries)
302	        except MessageError:
303	            # 查询截断或名字非法（含压缩问题）：EDNS 路径下统一为 EDNSError。
304	            raise EDNSError("invalid question name") from None
305	        if pos + 4 > len(data):
306	            raise EDNSError("question truncated")
307	        qtype = int.from_bytes(data[pos:pos + 2], "big")
308	        qclass = int.from_bytes(data[pos + 2:pos + 4], "big")
309	        pos += 4
310	        questions.append({"name": name, "type": qtype, "class": qclass})
311	    opt = None
312	    if arcount:
313	        if pos >= len(data):
314	            raise EDNSError("opt record truncated")
315	        if data[pos] != 0:
316	            raise EDNSError("opt owner must be uncompressed root")
317	        pos += 1
318	        if pos + 10 > len(data):
319	            raise EDNSError("opt record truncated")
320	        rrtype = int.from_bytes(data[pos:pos + 2], "big")
321	        rrclass = int.from_bytes(data[pos + 2:pos + 4], "big")
322	        ttl = int.from_bytes(data[pos + 4:pos + 8], "big")
323	        rdlength = int.from_bytes(data[pos + 8:pos + 10], "big")
324	        pos += 10
325	        if rrtype != _TYPE_OPT:
326	            raise EDNSError("additional record must be OPT")
327	        if rrclass < _MIN_OPT_CLASS:
328	            raise EDNSError("opt class out of range")
329	        if ttl >> 24 or (ttl >> 16) & 0xFF:
330	            raise EDNSError("opt extended rcode and version must be 0")
331	        if ttl & 0xFFFF & ~_FLAG_DO:
332	            raise EDNSError("opt flags must be DO only")
333	        if rdlength:
334	            raise EDNSError("opt rdlength must be 0")
335	        opt = (rrclass, bool(ttl & _FLAG_DO))
336	    if pos != len(data):
337	        raise EDNSError("trailing bytes")
338	    return {"id": msg_id, "flags": flags, "questions": questions}, opt

341	def _normalize_name(name):
342	    """按解码规则把 name 规范为小写绝对名，返回标签列表（根为 []）。"""
343	    if not isinstance(name, str):
344	        raise TypeError("name must be str")
345	    if not name.endswith("."):
346	        raise RecordError("name not absolute")
347	    parts = name[:-1].split(".") if name != "." else []
348	    labels = []
349	    wire_len = 1  # 根终止符占 1 字节
350	    for part in parts:
351	        label = part.lower()
352	        if not 1 <= len(label) <= _MAX_LABEL_LEN:
353	            raise RecordError("bad label length")
354	        if any(ch not in _LABEL_CHARS for ch in label):
355	            raise RecordError("invalid label character")
356	        labels.append(label)
357	        wire_len += len(label) + 1
358	        if wire_len > _MAX_NAME_WIRE_LEN:
359	            raise RecordError("name too long")
360	    return labels

363	def _normalize_owner_name(name):
364	    """规范 zone 记录 owner，允许最左标签恰为 "*" 的通配名。
365	
366	    返回标签列表；通配与否可由 labels[0] == "*" 判别。
367	    """
368	    if not isinstance(name, str):
369	        raise TypeError("name must be str")
370	    if not name.endswith("."):
371	        raise RecordError("name not absolute")
372	    parts = name[:-1].split(".") if name != "." else []
373	    labels = []
374	    wire_len = 1  # 根终止符占 1 字节
375	    for index, part in enumerate(parts):
376	        label = part.lower()
377	        if not 1 <= len(label) <= _MAX_LABEL_LEN:
378	            raise RecordError("bad label length")
379	        if index == 0 and label == "*":
380	            pass  # 唯一合法的通配形态：最左标签为单字符 "*"
381	        elif "*" in label or any(ch not in _LABEL_CHARS for ch in label):
382	            raise RecordError("invalid label character")
383	        labels.append(label)
384	        wire_len += len(label) + 1
385	        if wire_len > _MAX_NAME_WIRE_LEN:
386	            raise RecordError("name too long")
387	    return labels

395	def _validate_rr(rr, allow_wildcard=False):
396	    """校验单条 RR，返回 (labels, type, class, ttl, rdata)。"""
397	    if not isinstance(rr, dict):
398	        raise TypeError("rr must be dict")
399	    if list(rr.keys()) != _RR_KEYS:
400	        raise RecordError("rr keys must be name,type,class,ttl,rdata")
401	    if allow_wildcard:
402	        labels = _normalize_owner_name(rr["name"])
403	    else:
404	        labels = _normalize_name(rr["name"])
405	    rrtype = rr["type"]
406	    rrclass = rr["class"]
407	    ttl = rr["ttl"]
408	    rdata = rr["rdata"]
409	    _check_int(rrtype, "type")
410	    _check_int(rrclass, "class")
411	    _check_int(ttl, "ttl")
412	    if not isinstance(rdata, bytes):
413	        raise TypeError("rdata must be bytes")
414	    if not 0 <= rrtype <= 0xFFFF:
415	        raise RecordError("type out of range")
416	    if not 0 <= rrclass <= 0xFFFF:
417	        raise RecordError("class out of range")
418	    if not 0 <= ttl <= _MAX_TTL:
419	        raise RecordError("ttl out of range")
420	    if len(rdata) > _MAX_RDATA_LEN:
421	        raise RecordError("rdata too long")
422	    return labels, rrtype, rrclass, ttl, rdata

427	    if not isinstance(model, dict):

442	def _decode_cname_target(rdata):
443	    """把 CNAME rdata 按未压缩绝对名线格式解码为小写标签列表。
444	
445	    标签 1–63 字节、0 结尾、总长 ≤255；禁止压缩指针、尾随内容与非法字符。
446	    """
447	    if len(rdata) > _MAX_NAME_WIRE_LEN:
448	        raise RecordError("cname rdata too long")
449	    labels = []
450	    pos = 0
451	    while True:
452	        if pos >= len(rdata):
453	            raise RecordError("cname rdata not terminated")
454	        length = rdata[pos]
455	        if length == 0:
456	            pos += 1
457	            break
458	        if length > _MAX_LABEL_LEN:
459	            raise RecordError("cname rdata bad label length")
460	        pos += 1
461	        if pos + length > len(rdata):
462	            raise RecordError("cname rdata truncated")
463	        try:
464	            label = rdata[pos:pos + length].decode("ascii")
465	        except UnicodeDecodeError:
466	            raise RecordError("cname rdata label not ascii") from None
467	        if any(ch not in _LABEL_CHARS for ch in label):
468	            raise RecordError("cname rdata invalid label character")
469	        labels.append(label.lower())
470	        pos += length
471	    if pos != len(rdata):
472	        raise RecordError("cname rdata trailing bytes")
473	    return labels
474

476	def _encode_cname_target(labels):
477	    """把标签列表重编码为未压缩绝对名线格式。"""
478	    out = bytearray()
479	    for label in labels:
480	        out.append(len(label))
481	        out.extend(label.encode("ascii"))
482	    out.append(0)
483	    return bytes(out)

486	def _read_soa_name(rdata, pos):
487	    """按 CNAME 目标规范解码 rdata pos 处的未压缩绝对名，返回下一偏移。
488	
489	    任何格式问题都返回 None，不抛异常。
490	    """
491	    wire_len = 1  # 根终止符占 1 字节
492	    while True:
493	        if pos >= len(rdata):
494	            return None
495	        length = rdata[pos]
496	        if length == 0:
497	            return pos + 1
498	        if length > _MAX_LABEL_LEN:  # 含压缩指针形态
499	            return None
500	        pos += 1
501	        if pos + length > len(rdata):
502	            return None
503	        try:
504	            label = rdata[pos:pos + length].decode("ascii")
505	        except UnicodeDecodeError:
506	            return None
507	        if any(ch not in _LABEL_CHARS for ch in label):
508	            return None
509	        wire_len += length + 1
510	        if wire_len > _MAX_NAME_WIRE_LEN:
511	            return None
512	        pos += length

515	def _parse_soa_minimum(rdata):
516	    """解析 SOA rdata 的 minimum 字段（第五个网络序 uint32）。
517	
518	    rdata 须完整为两个未压缩绝对域名及五个网络序 uint32；
519	    格式不符返回 None，不抛异常。
520	    """
521	    pos = 0
522	    for _ in range(2):
523	        pos = _read_soa_name(rdata, pos)
524	        if pos is None:
525	            return None
526	    if len(rdata) - pos != 20:
527	        return None
528	    return int.from_bytes(rdata[pos + 16:pos + 20], "big")

531	def _negative_cache_entry(key, rcode, an, ns, now):
532	    """完整计划可负缓存时返回 (负缓存键, 条目)，否则返回 None。
533	
534	    规则与 PositiveCache 相同，但 ns 中唯一 SOA 的 owner 不受本地 origin
535	    约束（递归终态的 SOA 可能属于域外权威区）；键仍按本次查询构造。
536	    """
537	    if an or rcode not in (0, _RCODE_NXDOMAIN):
538	        return None
539	    if len(ns) != 1 or ns[0][1] != _TYPE_SOA:
540	        return None
541	    soa = ns[0]
542	    minimum = _parse_soa_minimum(soa[4])
543	    if minimum is None:
544	        return None
545	    neg_ttl = min(soa[3], minimum)
546	    if neg_ttl == 0:
547	        return None
548	    if rcode == _RCODE_NXDOMAIN:
549	        neg_key = ("nxdomain", key[0], key[2])  # 匹配任意 qtype
550	    else:
551	        neg_key = ("nodata",) + key
552	    return neg_key, (now, rcode, soa, neg_ttl)

555	def _validate_zone(zone):
556	    """校验 zone，返回 (origin 标签列表, 规范化 RR 列表, 统一 class)。"""
557	    if not isinstance(zone, dict):
558	        raise TypeError("zone must be dict")
559	    if list(zone.keys()) != _ZONE_KEYS:
560	        raise ZoneError("zone keys must be origin,records")
561	    try:
562	        origin = _normalize_name(zone["origin"])
563	    except RecordError as exc:
564	        raise ZoneError(str(exc)) from None
565	    records = zone["records"]
566	    if not isinstance(records, list):
567	        raise TypeError("records must be list")
568	    rrs = []
569	    for rr in records:
570	        labels, rrtype, rrclass, ttl, rdata = _validate_rr(
571	            rr, allow_wildcard=True)
572	        if rrtype == _TYPE_CNAME:
573	            # 目标规范成小写绝对名，rdata 据此重编码。
574	            rdata = _encode_cname_target(_decode_cname_target(rdata))
575	        rrs.append((labels, rrtype, rrclass, ttl, rdata))
576	    if not rrs:
577	        raise ZoneError("zone must contain a SOA record")
578	    rrclass = rrs[0][2]
579	    if any(rr[2] != rrclass for rr in rrs):
580	        raise ZoneError("record class not uniform")
581	    origin_soa = [rr for rr in rrs if rr[0] == origin and rr[1] == _TYPE_SOA]
582	    if len(origin_soa) != 1:
583	        raise ZoneError("origin must have exactly one SOA record")
584	    for labels, _rrtype, _cls, _ttl, _rdata in rrs:
585	        if labels and labels[0] == "*":
586	            suffix = labels[1:]
587	            if (len(suffix) < len(origin)
588	                    or suffix[len(suffix) - len(origin):] != origin):
589	                raise RecordError("wildcard suffix not within origin")
590	        elif (len(labels) < len(origin)
591	                or labels[len(labels) - len(origin):] != origin):
592	            raise ZoneError("owner not within origin")
593	    owner_types = {}
594	    for labels, rrtype, _cls, _ttl, _rdata in rrs:
595	        owner_types.setdefault(tuple(labels), []).append(rrtype)
596	    for types in owner_types.values():
597	        if _TYPE_CNAME in types and len(types) != 1:
598	            raise ZoneError("cname owner must hold exactly one cname record")
599	    return origin, rrs, rrclass

602	def _write_name(out, labels, offsets):
603	    """把域名写入 out；offsets 记录已出现的标签边界（后缀 -> 最小偏移）。"""
604	    match = 0
605	    target = None
606	    for i in range(len(labels)):
607	        suffix = tuple(labels[i:])
608	        if suffix in offsets:
609	            match = len(labels) - i
610	            target = offsets[suffix]
611	            break
612	    stop = len(labels) - match
613	    for i, label in enumerate(labels):
614	        if i >= stop:
615	            break
616	        if len(out) <= _MAX_POINTER_TARGET:
617	            offsets.setdefault(tuple(labels[i:]), len(out))
618	        out.append(len(label))
619	        out.extend(label.encode("ascii"))
620	    if target is not None:
621	        out.extend((0xC000 | target).to_bytes(2, "big"))
622	    else:
623	        out.append(0)

626	def _build_message(msg, an, ns, ar, rcode):
627	    """一次性编码完整报文，返回 (out, body_base, 各区段 RR 结束偏移, flags)。
628	
629	    尾删只保留报文前缀：压缩指针只指向更早写入的名字，保留的前缀
630	    自身即合法报文，故按结束偏移切片即可，无需反复重新编码。
631	    """
632	    flags = _FLAGS_RESPONSE | (msg["flags"] & _FLAGS_KEPT) | rcode
633	    out = bytearray()
634	    out += msg["id"].to_bytes(2, "big")
635	    out += flags.to_bytes(2, "big")
636	    out += len(msg["questions"]).to_bytes(2, "big")
637	    out += len(an).to_bytes(2, "big")
638	    out += len(ns).to_bytes(2, "big")
639	    out += len(ar).to_bytes(2, "big")
640	    offsets = {}
641	    for question in msg["questions"]:
642	        _write_name(out, _normalize_name(question["name"]), offsets)
643	        out += question["type"].to_bytes(2, "big")
644	        out += question["class"].to_bytes(2, "big")
645	    body_base = len(out)
646	    section_ends = []
647	    for section in (an, ns, ar):
648	        ends = []
649	        for labels, rrtype, rrclass, ttl, rdata in section:
650	            _write_name(out, labels, offsets)
651	            out += rrtype.to_bytes(2, "big")
652	            out += rrclass.to_bytes(2, "big")
653	            out += ttl.to_bytes(4, "big")
654	            out += len(rdata).to_bytes(2, "big")
655	            out += rdata
656	            ends.append(len(out))
657	        section_ends.append(ends)
658	    return out, body_base, section_ends, flags

661	def _encode_response(query, model, rcode):
662	    """把查询报文与应答模型编码为确定性权威应答报文（rcode 由内部指定）。"""
663	    if not isinstance(query, bytes):
664	        raise TypeError("query must be bytes")
665	    _check_int(rcode, "rcode")
666	    if not 0 <= rcode <= 0xF:
667	        raise EncodeError("rcode out of range")
668	    an, ns, ar, limit = _validate_model(model)
669	    msg = decode_query(query)
670	    if msg["flags"] & 0x8000:
671	        raise EncodeError("query has QR set")
672	    if not _MIN_LIMIT <= limit <= _MAX_LIMIT:
673	        raise EncodeError("limit out of range")
674	    truncated = False
675	    # 区段计数为 16 位：超过 65535 条时按 ar、ns、an 尾删整条并置 TC，
676	    # 不得让计数溢出。
677	    for section in (ar, ns, an):
678	        if len(section) > _MAX_SECTION_RECORDS:
679	            del section[_MAX_SECTION_RECORDS:]
680	            truncated = True
681	    out, body_base, (an_ends, ns_ends, ar_ends), flags = _build_message(
682	        msg, an, ns, ar, rcode)
683	    na, nn, nr = len(an), len(ns), len(ar)
684	    total_end = ar_ends[-1] if ar_ends else (
685	        ns_ends[-1] if ns_ends else (an_ends[-1] if an_ends else body_base))
686	    if total_end > limit:
687	        # 超长：先尾删 ar，ar 清空仍超长再尾删 ns，最后尾删 an。
688	        truncated = True
689	        nr = bisect_right(ar_ends, limit)
690	        if nr == 0:
691	            nn = bisect_right(ns_ends, limit)
692	            if nn == 0:
693	                na = bisect_right(an_ends, limit)
694	                if na == 0 and body_base > limit:
695	                    raise EncodeError("header and question exceed limit")
696	    if nr:
697	        end = ar_ends[nr - 1]
698	    elif nn:
699	        end = ns_ends[nn - 1]
700	    elif na:
701	        end = an_ends[na - 1]
702	    else:
703	        end = body_base
704	    result = bytearray(out[:end])
705	    result[6:8] = na.to_bytes(2, "big")
706	    result[8:10] = nn.to_bytes(2, "big")
707	    result[10:12] = nr.to_bytes(2, "big")
708	    if truncated:
709	        result[2:4] = (flags | _FLAG_TC).to_bytes(2, "big")
710	    return bytes(result)
711

718	def edns(query: bytes, model: dict, rcode: int = 0) -> bytes:
719	    """把（可含 OPT 的）查询报文与应答模型编码为 EDNS 应答报文。
720	
721	    query/model 的解码与编码契约同 decode_query/encode_response；查询
722	    AR 限 0 或 1 条，有则须为未压缩根 owner、TYPE41、CLASS512..65535、
723	    扩展码/版本 0、flags 仅 DO、RDLENGTH0 的 OPT。非法 AR/OPT、截断、
724	    尾随或 model 含 OPT 抛 EDNSError。rcode 须非 bool 整数（类型错
725	    TypeError）：有 OPT 限 0..4095、无 OPT 限 0..15，越界 EncodeError。
726	    无 OPT 时上限 min(model.limit, 512) 且不回 OPT；有 OPT 时上限
727	    min(model.limit, CLASS)，应答 ar 末项为同 CLASS 根 OPT，
728	    TTL=(rcode>>4)<<24|DO，头部低 4 位为 rcode&15。编码其余同
729	    encode_response：超限按 ar、ns、an 尾删并置 TC，OPT 不删；
730	    问题与 OPT 超限抛 EncodeError。
731	    """
732	    if not isinstance(query, bytes):
733	        raise TypeError("query must be bytes")
734	    _check_int(rcode, "rcode")
735	    an, ns, ar, limit = _validate_model(model)
736	    msg, opt = _decode_edns_query(query)
737	    for section in (an, ns, ar):
738	        if any(rr[1] == _TYPE_OPT for rr in section):
739	            raise EDNSError("model must not contain OPT records")
740	    if msg["flags"] & 0x8000:
741	        raise EncodeError("query has QR set")
742	    if not _MIN_LIMIT <= limit <= _MAX_LIMIT:
743	        raise EncodeError("limit out of range")
744	    opt_wire = b""
745	    if opt is None:
746	        if not 0 <= rcode <= 0xF:
747	            raise EncodeError("rcode out of range")
748	        limit = min(limit, _MAX_MESSAGE_LEN)
749	    else:
750	        if not 0 <= rcode <= _MAX_EDNS_RCODE:
751	            raise EncodeError("rcode out of range")
752	        opt_class, do = opt
753	        limit = min(limit, opt_class)
754	        ttl = ((rcode >> 4) << 24) | (_FLAG_DO if do else 0)
755	        opt_wire = (b"\x00" + _TYPE_OPT.to_bytes(2, "big")
756	                    + opt_class.to_bytes(2, "big") + ttl.to_bytes(4, "big")
757	                    + b"\x00\x00")
758	    truncated = False
759	    # 区段计数为 16 位：OPT 占 ar 一席且不删，model 的 ar 预算相应减一。
760	    max_ar = _MAX_SECTION_RECORDS - (1 if opt_wire else 0)
761	    if len(ar) > max_ar:
762	        del ar[max_ar:]
763	        truncated = True
764	    for section in (ns, an):
765	        if len(section) > _MAX_SECTION_RECORDS:
766	            del section[_MAX_SECTION_RECORDS:]
767	            truncated = True
768	    out, body_base, (an_ends, ns_ends, ar_ends), flags = _build_message(
769	        msg, an, ns, ar, rcode & 0xF)
770	    body_limit = limit - len(opt_wire)  # 为 OPT 预留，OPT 不参与尾删
771	    na, nn, nr = len(an), len(ns), len(ar)
772	    total_end = ar_ends[-1] if ar_ends else (
773	        ns_ends[-1] if ns_ends else (an_ends[-1] if an_ends else body_base))
774	    if total_end > body_limit:
775	        # 超长：先尾删 ar，ar 清空仍超长再尾删 ns，最后尾删 an。
776	        truncated = True
777	        nr = bisect_right(ar_ends, body_limit)
778	        if nr == 0:
779	            nn = bisect_right(ns_ends, body_limit)
780	            if nn == 0:
781	                na = bisect_right(an_ends, body_limit)
782	                if na == 0 and body_base > body_limit:
783	                    raise EncodeError("header and question exceed limit")
784	    if nr:
785	        end = ar_ends[nr - 1]
786	    elif nn:
787	        end = ns_ends[nn - 1]
788	    elif na:
789	        end = an_ends[na - 1]
790	    else:
791	        end = body_base
792	    result = bytearray(out[:end])
793	    result += opt_wire
794	    result[6:8] = na.to_bytes(2, "big")
795	    result[8:10] = nn.to_bytes(2, "big")
796	    result[10:12] = (nr + (1 if opt_wire else 0)).to_bytes(2, "big")
797	    if truncated:
798	        result[2:4] = (flags | _FLAG_TC).to_bytes(2, "big")

814	def _hop(records, nodes, origin, current, qtype):
815	    """单跳查找 current 的 qtype 记录，返回 (kind, rrs)。
816	
817	    kind 为 "answer"（rrs 为命中记录，通配 owner 已合成为 current）、
818	    "cname"（rrs 为合成后的单条 CNAME，仅 qtype≠5 时出现）、
819	    "nodata"（节点或通配存在但无该类型）或 "nxdomain"。
820	    """
821	    if tuple(current) in nodes:
822	        # 同名节点存在（含空非终端）：不回退通配。
823	        if qtype != _TYPE_CNAME:
824	            for rr in records:
825	                if rr[0] == current and rr[1] == _TYPE_CNAME:
826	                    return "cname", rr
827	        matched = [rr for rr in records
828	                   if rr[0] == current and rr[1] == qtype]
829	        if matched:
830	            return "answer", matched[:1] if qtype == _TYPE_CNAME else matched
831	        return "nodata", None
832	    # 节点不存在：取最长既存后缀，只检查 "*."+该后缀。
833	    encloser = None
834	    for i in range(1, len(current) - len(origin) + 1):
835	        if tuple(current[i:]) in nodes:
836	            encloser = current[i:]
837	            break
838	    wildcard = ["*"] + encloser
839	    if qtype != _TYPE_CNAME:
840	        for rr in records:
841	            if rr[0] == wildcard and rr[1] == _TYPE_CNAME:
842	                return "cname", (list(current), rr[1], rr[2], rr[3], rr[4])
843	    matched = [rr for rr in records
844	               if rr[0] == wildcard and rr[1] == qtype]
845	    if matched:
846	        if qtype == _TYPE_CNAME:
847	            matched = matched[:1]
848	        return "answer", [(list(current), rr[1], rr[2], rr[3], rr[4])
849	                          for rr in matched]
850	    if any(rr[0] == wildcard for rr in records):
851	        return "nodata", None
852	    return "nxdomain", None

855	def _resolve_chain(records, nodes, origin, qlabels, qtype):
856	    """在 origin 内解析（qtype≠5 时跟随 CNAME 链），返回 (rcode, an, ns)。"""
857	    soa = [rr for rr in records if rr[0] == origin and rr[1] == _TYPE_SOA]
858	    if qtype == _TYPE_CNAME:
859	        kind, rrs = _hop(records, nodes, origin, qlabels, qtype)
860	        if kind == "answer":
861	            return 0, rrs, []
862	        if kind == "nodata":
863	            return 0, [], soa
864	        return _RCODE_NXDOMAIN, [], soa
865	    an = []
866	    seen = {tuple(qlabels)}
867	    current = list(qlabels)
868	    while True:
869	        kind, rrs = _hop(records, nodes, origin, current, qtype)
870	        if kind == "answer":
871	            return 0, an + rrs, []
872	        if kind == "nodata":
873	            return 0, an, soa
874	        if kind == "nxdomain":
875	            return _RCODE_NXDOMAIN, an, soa
876	        # 命中 CNAME：先入链，再查目标；第 17 条或名称重复即失败。
877	        if len(an) >= _MAX_CNAME_CHAIN:
878	            raise CNAMEError("cname chain too long")
879	        an.append(rrs)
880	        target = _decode_cname_target(rrs[4])
881	        if tuple(target) in seen:
882	            raise CNAMEError("cname chain loop")
883	        seen.add(tuple(target))
884	        if (len(target) < len(origin)
885	                or target[len(target) - len(origin):] != origin):
886	            return 0, an, []  # 目标在 origin 外：返回积累链，ns 为空
887	        current = target

957	def _parse_zone_config(text):
958	    """解析 v0/v1/v2 配置文本，返回 (zone dict, version)。
959	
960	    仅做结构层校验：JSON 解析、重复键、版本、键序、字段类型、布尔整数
961	    与十六进制；错误统一抛 ConfigError。zone dict 键序 origin,records，
962	    rdata 为 bytes，名称原样保留，尚未按 zone 规则规范化。
963	    """
964	    if not isinstance(text, str):
965	        raise TypeError("text must be str")
966	    try:
967	        config = json.loads(text, object_pairs_hook=_config_pairs)
968	    except json.JSONDecodeError:
969	        raise ConfigError("invalid JSON") from None
970	    if not isinstance(config, dict):
971	        raise ConfigError("config must be an object")
972	    if list(config.keys()) not in (_CONFIG_KEYS, _CONFIG_KEYS_V2):
973	        raise ConfigError("invalid config key order")
974	    version = config["version"]
975	    _config_int(version, "version")
976	    if version not in (0, 1, 2):
977	        raise ConfigError("unsupported version")
978	    expected_keys = _CONFIG_KEYS_V2 if version == 2 else _CONFIG_KEYS
979	    if list(config.keys()) != expected_keys:
980	        raise ConfigError("config keys must match version")
981	    origin = config["origin"]
982	    if not isinstance(origin, str):
983	        raise ConfigError("origin must be str")
984	    records = config["records"]
985	    if not isinstance(records, list):
986	        raise ConfigError("records must be list")
987	    if version == 2:
988	        zone_class = config["class"]
989	        _config_int(zone_class, "class")
990	        if not 0 <= zone_class <= 0xFFFF:
991	            raise ConfigError("class out of range")
992	        rr_keys = _CONFIG_RR_KEYS_V2
993	        hex_key = "rdata"
994	    else:
995	        zone_class = None
996	        rr_keys = _CONFIG_RR_KEYS if version == 1 else _CONFIG_RR_KEYS_V0
997	        hex_key = "rdata" if version == 1 else "data"
998	    zone_records = []
999	    for rr in records:
1000	        if not isinstance(rr, dict):
1001	            raise ConfigError("record must be an object")
1002	        if list(rr.keys()) != rr_keys:
1003	            raise ConfigError("invalid record key order")
1004	        name = rr["name"]
1005	        if not isinstance(name, str):
1006	            raise ConfigError("name must be str")
1007	        _config_int(rr["type"], "type")
1008	        _config_int(rr["ttl"], "ttl")
1009	        if version == 2:
1010	            rrclass = zone_class
1011	        else:
1012	            _config_int(rr["class"], "class")
1013	            rrclass = rr["class"]
1014	        hextext = rr[hex_key]
1015	        if not isinstance(hextext, str):
1016	            raise ConfigError(hex_key + " must be str")
1017	        if (len(hextext) % 2
1018	                or any(c not in _LOWER_HEXDIGITS for c in hextext)):
1019	            raise ConfigError(
1020	                hex_key + " must be even-length lowercase hex")
1021	        zone_records.append({"name": name, "type": rr["type"],
1022	                             "class": rrclass, "ttl": rr["ttl"],
1023	                             "rdata": bytes.fromhex(hextext)})
1024	    return {"origin": origin, "records": zone_records}, version

1330	def _reply_question_end(reply, qdcount):
1331	    """按 qdcount 从偏移 12 起界定问题段结束位置；无法界定返回 None。"""
1332	    pos = _MIN_MESSAGE_LEN
1333	    for _ in range(qdcount):
1334	        while True:
1335	            if pos >= len(reply):
1336	                return None
1337	            length = reply[pos]
1338	            kind = length & 0xC0
1339	            if kind == 0xC0:
1340	                if pos + 1 >= len(reply):
1341	                    return None
1342	                pos += 2
1343	                break
1344	            if kind != 0x00:
1345	                return None
1346	            pos += 1
1347	            if length == 0:
1348	                break
1349	            if pos + length > len(reply):
1350	                return None
1351	            pos += length
1352	        if pos + 4 > len(reply):
1353	            return None
1354	        pos += 4

1358	def _matching_reply(query, reply):
1359	    """reply 是否为 query 的合格上游应答；任何不符均为普通失败。"""
1360	    if not _MIN_MESSAGE_LEN <= len(reply) <= _MAX_REPLY_LEN:
1361	        return False
1362	    if not int.from_bytes(reply[2:4], "big") & _FLAG_QR:
1363	        return False
1364	    if reply[0:2] != query[0:2] or reply[4:6] != query[4:6]:
1365	        return False
1366	    qdcount = int.from_bytes(query[4:6], "big")
1367	    end = _reply_question_end(reply, qdcount)
1368	    if end is None:
1369	        return False
1370	    return reply[_MIN_MESSAGE_LEN:end] == query[_MIN_MESSAGE_LEN:]

1373	def forward(query, plan, now, timeout=5):
1374	    """按 plan 顺序模拟向上游转发 query。
1375	
1376	    每项上游仅取前 2 个事件；时钟自 now 累计：delay > timeout 记超时并
1377	    推进 timeout，否则推进 delay 后检查应答（None 或不合格记失败）。
1378	    成功返回 (reply, name, 结束时刻)；全部超时抛 UpstreamTimeout，
1379	    其余耗尽情形（含无事件）抛 UpstreamError。
1380	    """
1381	    msg = decode_query(query)  # TypeError/MessageError 原样传播
1382	    if msg["flags"] & _FLAG_QR:
1383	        raise EncodeError("query has QR set")
1384	    _check_non_negative_int(now, "now")
1385	    _check_int(timeout, "timeout")
1386	    if not _MIN_TIMEOUT <= timeout <= _MAX_TIMEOUT:
1387	        raise ValueError("timeout out of range")
1388	    items = _validate_plan(plan)
1389	    clock = now
1390	    saw_timeout = False
1391	    saw_other = False
1392	    for name, events in items:
1393	        for delay, reply in events[:_PLAN_EVENTS_USED]:
1394	            if delay > timeout:
1395	                saw_timeout = True
1396	                clock += timeout
1397	                continue
1398	            clock += delay
1399	            if reply is not None and _matching_reply(query, reply):
1400	                return reply, name, clock
1401	            saw_other = True
1402	    if saw_timeout and not saw_other:
1403	        raise UpstreamTimeout("all upstream attempts timed out")
1404	    raise UpstreamError("no usable upstream reply")

1436	    None 表示该事件无应答；否则须为 (kind, an, ns)：

1445	        return None

1533	def _ratio_six(p, q):
1534	    """p/q 半偶舍入到 6 位小数的 JSON 数值字符串；分母 0 写 0.000000。"""
1535	    if q == 0:
1536	        return "0.000000"
1537	    quotient, remainder = divmod(p * 10**6, q)
1538	    if 2 * remainder > q:
1539	        quotient += 1
1540	    elif 2 * remainder == q and quotient % 2 == 1:
1541	        quotient += 1
1542	    return "{}.{:06d}".format(quotient // 10**6, quotient % 10**6)
